rust_summary: Namespaced, persistent Controls bindings and rising-edge input.
doc_summary: `register_key_binding(id, default_key, category, label)` registers up to 256 bindings in vanilla Controls, using translation keys for category and label. IDs belong to the calling mod. `key_binding_pressed(id)` fires once on a physical rising edge; `key_binding_state(id)` reads the held state. Focus loss releases all bindings. Saved names use `key_key.mod.namespace/path` without changing vanilla mappings. Requires API @API:key_bindings@.
